Subject: Co-funded pilot sponsorship request for GreenWave Logistics

Hi Evelyn,

Hope youre well. Quick note from Avalanche Systems (SI) — were scoping a 8-week pilot for GreenWave Logistics to validate a document ingestion + summarization flow. The customer is excited but procurement is asking for a trial extension and partner sponsorship to get internal approvals.

Were asking Redwood to co-fund the trial with a promotional allocation (token-based) that would cover roughly ~75k tokens over 8 weeks plus a 30-day trial extension. In return Avalanche will commit to a post-pilot roadmap and an opportunity for a 6–12 month paid deployment if KPIs are met.

Attached: pilot_scope.pdf (outline + test plan).

Can you advise who on your side coordinates partner-sponsored trial allocations and whether Redwood can approve this level of promotional allocation? Wed like to have an answer this week to keep the procurement window open.

Thanks — Ana

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Avalanches request for GreenWave (deal RNW-8427). Summary: SI asks for ~75k token allocation + 30-day trial extension to unblock procurement. Attached pilot scope.

My suggested guardrails:
- Approve up to 75k promotional tokens, expiring 60 days from activation.
- Activation requires: signed SOW (or DocuSign), completed Sponsorship_Form.xlsx, and HubSpot deal id linked (RNW-8427).
- Usage monitoring: enable alerting and weekly sync in first 2 weeks; if usage spikes 3x expected we will pause and review.

Reasoning: size matches expected pilot consumption and keeps our downside limited while giving AH the runway to convert. If we cant do full 75k, propose 50k + milestone top-up on conversion.

Ana — can Avalanche commit to the weekly check-ins and to sharing a finalized SOW by tomorrow? If yes, please upload the Sponsorship_Form.xlsx and well process.

Thanks — Evelyn
